description: The agent's answer at a step whose prompt asks for this schema.

parameters.description:
Survival estimates for 36 population cohorts.
Each field is {cohort_id}__s{horizon} where horizon is 12, 24, or 36 months.

Cohort definitions:
  voc_3_6: 3 <= voc_mg_l < 6
  acron_lt2: acron_use_avg < 2
  family_history_yes: family_history = yes
  hhbp_gte8: hhbp_serum_level >= 8
  avoc_high_prb1_lt25: ambient_voc_ppb >= 15 AND prb1_ratio < 25
  avoc_high_education_gte16: ambient_voc_ppb >= 15 AND years_of_education >= 16
  avoc_gte15_gg1: ambient_voc_ppb >= 15 AND genotype_group = GG-1
  family_history_gg3: family_history = yes AND genotype_group = GG-3
  family_history_prb1_gte28: family_history = yes AND prb1_ratio >= 28
  education_gte16_cognitive_lt050: years_of_education >= 16 AND cognitive_score (low: MMSE < 23 | MoCA < 20 | AD8 > 4)
  education_gte16_gg3: years_of_education >= 16 AND genotype_group = GG-3
  education_lt13_gg1: years_of_education < 13 AND genotype_group = GG-1
  acron_lt2_prb1_24_28: acron_use_avg < 2 AND 24 <= prb1_ratio < 28
  prb1_gte28_acron_gte4: prb1_ratio >= 28 AND acron_use_avg >= 4
  voc_3_6_prb1_lt25: 3 <= voc_mg_l < 6 AND prb1_ratio < 25
  gg3_voc_lt3: genotype_group = GG-3 AND voc_mg_l < 3
  age_gte55_acron_gte4: age >= 55 AND acron_use_avg >= 4
  cognitive_lt050_age_lt55: cognitive_score (low: MMSE < 23 | MoCA < 20 | AD8 > 4) AND age < 55
  hhbp_gte8_prb1_lt25: hhbp_serum_level >= 8 AND prb1_ratio < 25
  age_40_60_voc_gte5: 40 <= age < 60 AND voc_mg_l >= 5
  avoc_high_family_history_prb1_gte28: ambient_voc_ppb >= 15 AND family_history = yes AND prb1_ratio >= 28
  education_high_voc_high_acron_low: years_of_education >= 16 AND voc_mg_l >= 5 AND acron_use_avg < 2
  family_history_gg3_voc_gte5: family_history = yes AND genotype_group = GG-3 AND voc_mg_l >= 5
  avoc_high_cognitive_low_family_history: ambient_voc_ppb >= 15 AND cognitive_score (low: MMSE < 23 | MoCA < 20 | AD8 > 4) AND family_history = yes
  education_low_prb1_gte28_gg3: years_of_education < 13 AND prb1_ratio >= 28 AND genotype_group = GG-3
  acron_high_hhbp_high_prb1_lt25: acron_use_avg >= 4 AND hhbp_serum_level >= 8 AND prb1_ratio < 25
  family_history_education_gte16_prb1_lt25: family_history = yes AND years_of_education >= 16 AND prb1_ratio < 25
  avoc_low_voc_high_age_40_60: ambient_voc_ppb < 10 AND voc_mg_l >= 5 AND 40 <= age < 60
  age_gte60_gg3_education_gte16: age >= 60 AND genotype_group = GG-3 AND years_of_education >= 16
  prb1_lt25_voc_gte5_acron_lt2: prb1_ratio < 25 AND voc_mg_l >= 5 AND acron_use_avg < 2
  gg1_family_history_cognitive_lt050: genotype_group = GG-1 AND family_history = yes AND cognitive_score (low: MMSE < 23 | MoCA < 20 | AD8 > 4)
  prb1_gte30_acron_gte4_voc_lt3: prb1_ratio >= 30 AND acron_use_avg >= 4 AND voc_mg_l < 3
  avoc_gte15_gg1_age_gte55: ambient_voc_ppb >= 15 AND genotype_group = GG-1 AND age >= 55
  cognitive_gte075_age_gte60_gg3: cognitive_score (high: MMSE >= 26 | MoCA >= 23 | AD8 <= 2) AND age >= 60 AND genotype_group = GG-3
  cognitive_lt050_prb1_gte28_acron_lt2: cognitive_score (low: MMSE < 23 | MoCA < 20 | AD8 > 4) AND prb1_ratio >= 28 AND acron_use_avg < 2
  gg3_education_gte16_voc_3_6: genotype_group = GG-3 AND years_of_education >= 16 AND 3 <= voc_mg_l < 6
